o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian نَرْگِسِ شَهْلَا (nargis-i šahlā).
From Early Old Oghuz يوز ارلك (yü:z erlik), ultimately from Proto-Oghuz *yüzerlik (“harmal; ruta montana”). Cognate with Turkish üzerlik and Turkmen üzärlik.
